scope: Complete original routines run unchanged. New full APIs compare exact 32-bit EAX and every byte of 0x1000 object storage; elapsed/copy/byte setters return object tokens, times twelve stores/returns the product, fills return object+count, slot clearing returns object+0x1c and predicates return 0/1. Mapped object identities include 0xfffffffc with split wrapping guest storage, proving end-token wrap. Legacy APIs compare state/out-parameters only. 43ba70 legacy bonus flag remains a projected output here; its existing exact-return bonus_ready API is separately verified in player_slots. Invalid native storage/ranges return zero without writes.
